2/ Why is HMPV serious? 🧠

HMPV’s seasonal occurrence is relatively ignored due to the overshadowing focus on RSV and flu, but data suggests HMPV has a similar percentage.

😷 However, with no vaccination or treatment available, we have no option to deal with it.
